brief:
An inquiry into a Sydney demonstration against Israeli President Isaac Herzog's visit has found limited evidence of protester violence, The Guardian reported. Hearings into the rally heard testimony that protesters were "largely peaceful," according to the inquiry proceedings.

The investigation comes amid allegations of police brutality at the event. Authorities are examining the conduct of both demonstrators and law enforcement during the rally.
